searchText: Proposal 1 = add _yet another_ piece of logic into consensus-sensitive code If selfdestruct were neutered (turned into a SEND ALL ETH opcode), would it then be possible to do the attack were a relayer uses just enough gas to create the vault contract, but not execute the order, and then in the next transaction call the vault contract directly with a custom calldata that just sends the funds to themselves? Would this affect ALL funds lying in vaults? One fix would be to add a check in each vault contract that ensures the caller is pinecore, but that would probably mean a new version of pinecore. I think it wouldn't, because if the trade doesn't happen the whole transaction reverts, including the initial create the issue with cancel is that doesn't happen, I mean the revert Ahh, I see. So IIUC, only users who try to cancel an order with too little gas would have their funds exposed, but this could be prevented by increasing the gas limit in the front-end.
